item.title: Despite some big losses, Supreme Court rewards Trump's power play
item.description:
Source: Straits Times World (Global)
WASHINGTON, July 1 - On Tuesday, the U.S. Supreme Court ended Donald Trump's quest to narrow who can be considered a citizen if born in the United States, a harsh loss for the Republican president.
